headline: World Sky Cultures
body: One sky. The desert people saw — a calendar.
notes: EN04 p1 開場字卡 — 3 s to next — World Sky Cultures / One sky. The desert people saw — a calendar. / Desert people watched the Pleiades to know when the rain would come.

body: Desert seasons are hard to tell from the land — so people read the stars.
notes: EN04 p2 鏡頭01開始 — 3 s to next — Desert seasons are hard to tell from the land — so people read the stars.

headline: The year opens with the Pleiades
body: Around June 7, al-Thurayyā (the Pleiades) first appears before dawn, and summer begins.
notes: EN04 p8 鏡頭03-概念圖收＝鏡頭04開始 — 3 s to next — The year opens with the Pleiades / Around June 7, al-Thurayyā (the Pleiades) first appears before dawn, and summer begins.

headline: Mid-October: the rains
body: The rainy season starts — al-Wasm, “the brand.” The first rain brands dry land green.
notes: EN04 p13 鏡頭07-中1 — 4 s to next — Mid-October: the rains / The rainy season starts — al-Wasm, “the brand.” The first rain brands dry land green.

body: Legend says this rain becomes pearls at sea — truffles on sand.

headline: December 7: al-Iklīl, “the Crown”
body: Before dawn, the Scorpion’s head rises in the east as the Pleiades set in the west.
notes: EN04 p16 鏡頭08結束 — 8 s to next — December 7: al-Iklīl, “the Crown” / Before dawn, the Scorpion’s head rises in the east as the Pleiades set in the west.

body: Before Islam, people believed stars setting at dawn brought rain — the Pleiades most of all.

body: December 7 starts the desert’s forty coldest days: al-Murabbaʿāniyya.
notes: EN04 p22 鏡頭09結束＝鏡頭10開始 — 5 s to next — December 7 starts the desert’s forty coldest days: al-Murabbaʿāniyya.

headline: Over 1,000 years ago, Arabs said
body: “When the Pleiades rise at nightfall, the shepherd looks for a cloak.”
notes: EN04 p26 鏡頭11開始 — 6 s to next — Over 1,000 years ago, Arabs said / “When the Pleiades rise at nightfall, the shepherd looks for a cloak.”

headline: Look east after dark
body: This month, the Pleiades are already up, with red Aldebaran below.
notes: EN04 p27 鏡頭11結束＝鏡頭12開始 — 6 s to next — Look east after dark / This month, the Pleiades are already up, with red Aldebaran below.

headline: Next · Monday, December 21
body: Winter solstice: a year measured by a stick.
notes: EN04 p46 端卡（下集見） — 4 s to next — Next · Monday, December 21 / Winter Solstice: A Year Measured by a Stick / One stick and its shadow can measure a whole year.
